items.title: An etale morphism to a closed subscheme can be covered by restrictions of etale morphisms to the ambient scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a Zariski covering of an etale Z-scheme V by restrictions of etale X-schemes along a closed immersion i : Z -> X (statement lines 6620-6627). The proof is a localization reduction: because the conclusion only asks for a Zariski covering, one may localize on X and V and thereby assume both affine (proof lines 6630-6632), after which the affine case is exactly the cited lifting result from the chapter Algebra (proof lines 6632-6633). The content is the recognition that the assertion is Zariski local, which is what licenses the reduction to the affine situation. The claim is H2: one localisation reduction plus one cited affine statement.
